desc.zh: 排椅子、鋪桌巾、掛海報與指引牌；演出結束後協助撤場復原。
desc.en: Arrange chairs, lay tablecloths, hang posters and signs; help restore the hall after the concert.

skills.zh: 無經驗可，現場會分組帶
skills.en: No experience needed, grouped on site

desc.zh: 協助搬運與架設音響設備、麥克風測試、現場試音與演出中監聽。
desc.en: Move and set up sound gear, test microphones, run sound check and monitor during the show.

skills.zh: 有基本音響概念佳（會有人帶）
skills.en: Basic audio knowledge a plus (training provided)

title.zh: 舞台燈光與鋼琴位置協助

desc.zh: 依節目順序調整燈光、協助鋼琴與譜架位置擺放。
desc.en: Adjust lighting cue by cue and help position the piano and music stands.

desc.zh: 入口簽到桌、發放節目單、引導觀眾入座並協助長輩。
desc.en: Run the check-in desk, hand out programmes, guide guests to seats and help elderly attendees.

place.zh: 生技園區 入口大廳

desc.zh: 拍攝彩排與演出照片，需自備相機，重點捕捉孩子們的表情。
desc.en: Shoot rehearsal and performance photos. Bring your own camera; focus on the kids’ expressions.

skills.zh: 自備相機、熟悉室內低光拍攝
skills.en: Own camera; comfortable with low-light indoor shooting

place.zh: 生技園區 觀眾席後方
place.en: Taipei Bio Park — rear of auditorium

desc.zh: 架設腳架全程錄影；會後協助整理成一支精華影片（可在家完成）。
desc.en: Set up a tripod for full recording; later help cut a highlight video (can be done from home).

skills.zh: 自備相機或手機穩定器；會剪輯佳
skills.en: Own camera or gimbal; editing skills a plus

place.zh: 生技園區 觀眾席中央
place.en: Taipei Bio Park — centre of auditorium

desc.zh: 會前擺設茶點桌、中場協助分送飲水與點心、會後收拾。
desc.en: Set up the refreshment table, serve drinks and snacks at intermission, clean up afterwards.

skills.en: Energetic and quick on your feet

place.zh: 生技園區 後方迴廊

desc.zh: 後台休息區陪伴候場的孩子、協助帶隊上下台與上洗手間。
desc.en: Stay with children waiting backstage, escort them on and off stage and to the restroom.

place.zh: 生技園區 後台休息室

title.zh: 節目單印製與現場發放

desc.zh: 協助校對與印製節目單（會前在家可協助）、現場補充分發。
desc.en: Help proofread and print the programme (can be done from home beforehand) and restock on site.

title.zh: 會後問卷與照片整理上傳

desc.zh: 演出後協助發放線上回饋問卷、整理照片並上傳到社群相簿。
desc.en: Send out the online feedback survey and organise photos into the community album.

skills.zh: 會用 Google 表單／雲端硬碟

desc.zh: 協助搬運鋼琴以外的樂器、譜架與打擊樂器，協助調音師。
desc.en: Help move instruments, stands and percussion gear; assist the tuner.

skills.en: Able to lift moderately heavy items

desc.zh: 在會場周邊協助引導來賓停車與前往會場的路線。
desc.en: Guide guests to parking around the venue and direct them to the hall.

skills.en: Familiar with the Nangang area a plus
